title: Q-YEAR-live-owner-list: generate the owner list from live state
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** UNATTENDED-365 register, dependency `live-owner-list` is open
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation unattended --probe live-owner-list
**Status:** open

Render NEEDS-YOU.md and /needs-you from GET /api/v1/owner-acts plus doctrine/unattended.json gates, close D1 gate card GATE-SECRET-ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (agents run on Workers AI), and drop the typed items.
When it holds, set the dependency's status to closed in doctrine/unattended.json with the evidence and a probe that proves it.
